text: {"lessons":["I often sold stocks after gains, then bought stocks again at different prices; I should set position and rebalancing rules instead of treating a gain as an automatic reason to sell.","I added to several positions repeatedly, including after prices fell. Averaging down is not automatically wise: I should reassess each stock’s risks and prospects and avoid concentrating my cash in it.","My account value rose overall, but short-term gains do not prove that my trading decisions are sound. I should evaluate decisions by their rationale, portfolio risk and long-term results, not recent performance."]}
